articles.summary: Simply Wall St.: Medtronic Expands AI Heart Care As Investors Weigh Valuation And Momentum. Medtronic (NYSE:MDT) has completed its acquisition of CathWorks, adding AI based coronary diagnostic tools to its cardiovascular portfolio. The company has also led a $100 million investment in Pulnovo Medical to support therapies for cardiovascular disease and hypertension. These transactions expand Medtronic's reach in AI driven heart care and global medical device commercialisation.
